title: The Russian Revolution
key_facts: Abolition of the Tsarist autocracy in the February Revolution of 1917.
Bolsheviks led by Vladimir Lenin seized power in the October Revolution.
Civil war between the Red Army (Bolsheviks) and White Army (anti-communists).
Establishment of the Soviet Union (USSR) in 1922.
causes: Widespread poverty and famine exasperated by World War I.
Autocratic rule of Tsar Nicholas II and refusal to reform.
Rapid industrialization leading to poor worker conditions.
outcome: End of the Romanov dynasty and the Russian Empire.
Creation of the world's first communist state.
Start of a global ideological conflict between communism and capitalism.

figures.name: Vladimir Lenin
figures.role: Bolshevik leader and founder of the USSR

figures.name: Leon Trotsky
figures.role: Key revolutionary and leader of the Red Army

impacts: Withdrawal of Russia from World War I via the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk.
Redistribution of land and nationalization of industry.
